question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: PROPITIATE
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Appease.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Propitiate"** means to win or regain the favor of someone by doing something that pleases them. (प्रसन्न करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The villagers offered sacrifices to propitiate the angry gods.
 
 
 
• **"Appease"** means to pacify or make someone less angry by satisfying their demands or requests. (शांत करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She tried to appease her upset friend by apologizing and offering a gift.
 
 
 
• Hence, "Appease" is the synonym of "Propitiate".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Agitate** (उत्तेजित करना): To disturb, upset, or make someone nervous.

 
 
• **Example:** The loud noise agitated the baby and made him cry.
 
 
 
• **Provoke** (उकसाना): To incite someone to act in a certain way, often in anger.
 
 
• **Example:** His rude comments provoked an argument between the team members.
 
 
 
• **Enrage** (क्रोधित करना): To make someone extremely angry.
 
 
• **Example:** The unfair treatment of workers enraged the protesters.
